name: Khatam Masjid
summary: A compact mosque sits within a broad eight-point seal, combining Islamic geometry with a clear architectural center.
why: The seal has exact radial symmetry and a generous true gap around the mosque. The minaret joins the prayer hall, while the dome and entrance share one centerline. Large geometry carries the ornament without fine decorative noise.
risk: The seal can read as a formal badge, and its inner mosque is smaller than the other two proposals.
reasonToChoose: You want a compact geometric emblem with a mosque at its center.
